title: IA home folders resolve through one authoritative location
summary: The runtime reads and writes each IA home folder (work, sessions, kit-roots, installed-kits, method-closures) at one authoritative place: the plain folder when it holds an authoritative marker file, otherwise the existing *-v1 folder. No folder moves, the plain folder and marker are never created, and paths on a machine without a marker are unchanged; a later release performs the cutover.
